pull.title: MINOR: Test that request header v3 is unsupported before IBP_4_5_IV0
pull.body:
`ShareCoordinatorMetadataCacheHelperImplTest` covered
`isRequestHeaderV3Supported()` at `IBP_4_5_IV0` and when the metadata
version is unknown, but not at an older metadata version. This adds a
test that it returns false at `IBP_4_4_IV2`, the version just before the
request header v3 gate.

Reviewers: Andrew Schofield <aschofield@confluent.io>
